title: Abyssals v0.90.36 — Willowglass & Keepers
notes: Five permanent Egg Pouch upgrades from Philomere’s apothecary and later general stores: 10,000 / 20,000 / 40,000 / 80,000 / 160,000 doubloons for capacities 4 / 5 / 6 / 8 / 10. Existing saves start at their original three slots; upgrades preserve eggs and progress. Discover the scenic old wooden Willowglass Viaduct through Philomere’s southern garden arch. Dedicated high-end pixel art shows ivy-covered timber supports over a vast misty evergreen marsh. A fixed aerial view keeps both ends on screen; tap either end to walk the full 360 ordinary steps across. Every carried egg progresses normally, including all ten; a return trip readies a fresh 512-step egg. No bonus steps for entering, idling, tapping or loading. Bridge coordinates and pouch purchases survive save export/import. Retains two-parent Prodigy inheritance, permanent growth, prices, lives, quests and original APK signing.
